feed.title: Dr. Pietro Carlo Boldini
feed.subtitle: Postdoctoral researcher at TU Delft working on laminar–turbulent transition, compressible and supercritical fluid flows, stability analysis, direct numerical simulations.

entry.title: Invited talk at SACAW 2026, SURF, Utrecht (the Netherlands)

link.title: Invited talk at SACAW 2026, SURF, Utrecht (the Netherlands)

entry.content:
I gave an invited talk, “Porting CUBENS to GPUs: A high-fidelity solver for non-ideal fluid flows”, at the 2nd Symposium on Accelerated Computing for Application Workflows (SACAW 2026) at SURF in Utrecht (the Netherlands).

A report on the symposium is available on the SURF Communities website: SACAW 2026: 2nd Symposium on Accelerated Computing for Application Workflows.
entry.summary: I gave an invited talk, “Porting CUBENS to GPUs: A high-fidelity solver for non-ideal fluid flows”, at the 2nd Symposium on Accelerated Computing for Application Workflows (SACAW 2026) at SURF in Utrecht (the Netherlands).
